title: Declining to promise the reeve on the barrow doors is explicitly reversible ('Ask again if you change your mind') and no promise is ever broken, yet leaving the doors open still cost Watch standing with a line that half-acknowledges the unfairness ('No promise broken... Still, the Watch marks it, promised or not').
where: Last Light Square - reeve dialogue, 'ask about the doors, left open'
